examples.title: One tool, one widget
examples.pattern: One tool = one flat component. The model only fills params; there is no routing decision.

examples.title: One chat, four widgets
examples.pattern: Several tools = several widgets. The model has to route, and routing can go wrong.

examples.title: Four widgets on a design system
examples.pattern: Four tools, four widgets, built on shadcn/ui. The model picks a tool and fills its input; the client's component map brings the design system.

examples.title: Dashboard on json-render
examples.pattern: The model composes a dashboard from a shadcn/ui catalog: a flat {root, elements} spec streamed per node, $state data binding, on.* actions.
